behavior: Persist workflow state to a PostgreSQL checkpointer at every node boundary of the agent-harness workflow so an interrupted run can be reloaded from its latest durable checkpoint.
nonGoals: No resume orchestration or interrupt handling (HAR-004-T01)
No adapter, transport or evidence code path changes
No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: protectedTests HAR-002 is the catalog suite covering HAR-003, HAR-004, HAR-005, HAR-006 and HAR-010 (verification/test-catalog.json); per CP-002's ruling this suite will be re-cut into per-requirement sub-suites, and this contract cites the current catalog entry pending that amendment. runnerDigest is the attested G0 runner image pending a G1 runner attestation; task-ready v1 does not verify runnerDigest or testSourceDigest. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 46c8cf99cbac5d0c87729e08db20bbadbe2bacd0, computed by calling the runner's own runnerDigests() in src/evidence.ts directly rather than invented. @structile/agent-harness currently declares zero runtime dependencies; persisting checkpoints to PostgreSQL needs a client library, so allowedPaths adds packages/agent-harness/package.json plus root package-lock.json (listed in generatedPaths, excluded from line-count as a reproducible lockfile companion per the schema). No shared db-test-helper convention exists yet anywhere in this repo (checked compose.yaml, README.md and apps/foundation-health/src/index.ts); tests reach PostgreSQL via the existing STRUCTILE_POSTGRES_HOST/STRUCTILE_POSTGRES_PORT env-var convention already established for foundation-health, brought up locally with a compose step adapted from the README's STRUCTILE_DEV_POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE convention (postgres service only, detached), so no path outside packages/agent-harness/** plus the two dependency-declaration files is needed.
